test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 6 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7(1/5) hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling time by pump = 6 hours

Filling time with leakage = 7tfrac{1}{5} hours = tfrac{36}{5} hours

**Formula used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Net rate = Filling rate − Leakage rate

**Calculation:**

LCM of 6 and 36/5 = 36

Pump fills = 36 ÷ 6 = 6 units/hour

Net fill = 36 ÷ (36/5) = 5 units/hour

Leak rate = 6 − 5 = 1 unit/hour

Time taken by leak to empty full tank = 36 ÷ 1 = 36 hours

**∴ Leak will empty the full tank in 36 hours.**
